Undo and redo

Source: R/undo.R
undo.Rd

An undo manager tracks the local changes made to a document after it is created, and can undo and redo them. Changes imported from other replicas are never undone: an undo reverses only this replica's own edits, adjusted for whatever others have done since.

  • doc_undo_manager() creates an undo manager for doc.

  • undo() and redo() step backward and forward. If there is no step to take they do nothing, or with strict = TRUE raise an error.

  • can_undo() and can_redo() report whether a step is available.

  • undo_count() and redo_count() return the number of steps available.

  • undo_group() evaluates code and records all the changes it makes as a single undo step. Pending edits are committed when the group starts and when it ends, so the step contains exactly the edits made by code. Groups cannot be nested. If changes to the same container are imported from another replica while the group is open, Loro closes the step early and the group is recorded as more than one step. With strict = TRUE it is an error for code to make no edits.

  • undo_pause() stops recording local edits as undo steps until undo_resume(); undo_is_paused() reports the state. Edits made while paused cannot be undone.

  • undo_clear() discards all undo and redo steps.

Checking out another version with doc_checkout() clears the undo and redo history.

Undoing the deletion of a child container brings back its contents in a new container with a new id. Handles to the old container remain deleted (see container_is_deleted()), so fetch the container again from its parent after an undo.

Each commit is one undo step, so call doc_commit() between edits that should be undone separately. Commits closer together than merge_interval are combined into one step.

Usage

doc_undo_manager(
  doc,
  merge_interval = 0,
  max_steps = 100,
  exclude_origins = character()
)

undo_count(manager)

redo_count(manager)

undo_pause(manager)

undo_resume(manager)

undo_is_paused(manager)

undo_clear(manager)

undo(manager, strict = FALSE)

redo(manager, strict = FALSE)

can_undo(manager)

can_redo(manager)

undo_group(manager, code, strict = FALSE)

Arguments

doc

A loro_doc.

merge_interval

Commits made within this many seconds of the previous one join its undo step. The default, 0, keeps every commit separate.

max_steps

Maximum number of undo steps to keep.

exclude_origins

A character vector of origin prefixes. Commits whose origin (see doc_commit()) starts with one of them are not recorded as undo steps.

manager

An undo manager from doc_undo_manager().

strict

Whether doing nothing is an error: for undo() and redo(), having no step to take, and for undo_group(), code making no edits.

code

Code that edits the document.

Value

doc_undo_manager() returns an undo manager. undo(), redo(), undo_group(), undo_pause(), undo_resume(), and undo_clear() return manager invisibly. can_undo(), can_redo(), and undo_is_paused() return a logical, and undo_count() and redo_count() an integer.

Examples

doc = loro_doc()
text = doc_text(doc)
manager = doc_undo_manager(doc)

text_insert(text, 1, "Hello")
doc_commit(doc)
text_insert(text, 6, " world")
doc_commit(doc)

undo(manager)
text_get(text)
#> [1] "Hello"
redo(manager)
text_get(text)
#> [1] "Hello world"
